english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken adverb when someone follows a rule or instruction without relaxing it.

examples.english: I strictly follow my boss’s instructions and don’t add anything myself.
examples.traditional: 嚴格咁跟足上司嘅指示做，唔好自己加料。
